query:
SELECT
                l1_batch_number,
                EXTRACT(
                    EPOCH
                    FROM
                    NOW() - created_at
                )::BIGINT AS "age_secs!"
            FROM
                proof_generation_details
            WHERE
                l1_batch_number >= $1
                AND (
                    vm_run_data_blob_url IS NULL
                    OR proof_gen_data_blob_url IS NULL
                )
            ORDER BY
                l1_batch_number ASC
            LIMIT
                1
